    • availability

      public PaginatedList<Ibx> availability(ConnectionType connectionType, String accessPointType, String assetType)
      Description copied from interface: InternetAccessIbxs
      Returns the IBXs where Equinix Internet Access is available, narrowed by connection access point type and required asset type.
      Specified by:
      availability in interface InternetAccessIbxs
      Parameters:
      connectionType - the service connection type (IA_C physical or IA_VC virtual)
      accessPointType - the connection A-side access point type (e.g. COLO, VD, PORT), or null for the default (COLO)
      assetType - the type of asset the user must have in the IBX (e.g. CABINET), or null for no asset constraint
      Returns:
      a paginated list of matching IBXs
